AS_OF_WORKTREE_STATE: CLEAN at the base and at each of the three merge commits.

PURPOSE.rule: ONE consolidated successor package for the D-1 auditor capability, replacing what would otherwise have become three more parallel authority chains.
PURPOSE.what_it_consolidates: The three independently certified child packages for DAG nodes N05, N06 and N07, merged non-destructively and byte-intact, plus the three certification occurrences those reviews produced, plus the repair of three gaps in the certified provisioning DAG that the reviews exposed.
PURPOSE.what_it_deliberately_is_NOT: It is not an execution lane, not an implementation, not a provisioning act, and not a closure of any DAG node. It makes previously structureless gaps EXECUTABLE and prepares ONE later custody-realization sequence. It performs no part of that sequence.
PURPOSE.why_consolidation_rather_than_three_succ: Each child package independently recorded findings about the SAME graph. Three separate successor chains would each have had to re-derive the same DAG, and a gap that appears in two of them would have been repaired twice, differently. One package repairs it once.

INTEGRATION_RECORD.method: Three non-destructive merges in the deterministic order the lane mandate fixes. No rebase, no force-push, no cherry-pick, no squash. Each child branched directly from the same base and touched a disjoint path set, so each merge is a PURE UNION.

UNION_PURITY_PROOF.method: git diff --name-status between the base and the merge head.
UNION_PURITY_PROOF.verdict: PURE UNION. Not one file present at the base was modified or removed by the merges.

CHILD_BLOB_BYTE_IDENTITY.method: Git blob OIDs for all ten child artifacts were captured from the three source commits BEFORE the merges and compared against the same paths at the merge head. A blob OID is the hash of the exact bytes, so an OID match IS byte equality — and it is immune to the CRLF round-tripping this repository's Windows checkouts perform, because the stored blob is LF either way.

SEMANTIC_CONFLICT_CHECK.question: The lane mandate requires a STOP on semantic or path conflict. Was there one?
SEMANTIC_CONFLICT_CHECK.path_conflict: NONE. The three children's path sets are pairwise disjoint.
SEMANTIC_CONFLICT_CHECK.semantic_conflict: NONE FOUND. The three packages make claims about the same graph but none contradicts another. Where two of them touch the same subject — N05's readiness and N06's delivery-mechanism field — the N06 entry already carries the caveat that recording the ratified mechanism choice is not a claim that N05 has closed, which is exactly what the N05 package independently concludes.

DAG_GAP_REPAIRS.rule: Three gaps, three governed acts, one amendment. The amendment is the operative artifact; this section states what it does and why, and does not duplicate its node text.

DAG_GAP_A.placement: Upstream of N05, downstream of N03.

DAG_GAP_A.NO_INSECURE_IMPLEMENTATION_CHOSEN_TO_CLO: No reader, wrapper, script, command, API or library is named. The node authorizes a FUTURE technical lane under hard constraints: no secret in argv, no secret in logs, no secret in the repository tree, no persistent user environment, no invented secret.
DAG_GAP_A.THE_BUILDER_MUST_NOT_SELF_CERTIFY_N05: N29's exit condition stops at a built, invocable, named mechanism with its invocation contract enforced. Demonstrating WCM-C1..WCM-C5 is N05 and belongs to a different actor. A builder who also certifies the build has produced a self-report.

DAG_GAP_B.gap: N11 mints the credential, N23 READS it from the vault, and no node deposits it into the vault between them.
DAG_GAP_B.closed_by_node: N30, CREDENTIAL DEPOSIT INTO THE RATIFIED CUSTODY STORE
DAG_GAP_B.placement: Strictly between N11 and N23, machine-verified by REACHABILITY over the edge set (N30 reachable from N11, N23 reachable from N30) rather than by position in a topological order, which is not unique and would not have proven the dependency.
DAG_GAP_B.KEPT_SEPARATE_FROM_SELECTION_AND_BUILD: N29 produces a READER; N30 performs a WRITE. The two semantics are NOT fused. Fusing them would let one lane both place a secret and certify the mechanism that retrieves it.
DAG_GAP_B.KEPT_SEPARATE_FROM_N12: N12 updates the custody INVENTORY, a names-and-roles repository record. N30 writes a VALUE into an OS credential vault. Neither substitutes for the other.

No secret evidence: the deposit is recorded by mechanism name only.

DAG_GAP_C.gap: N06 requires planned_removal_date and no node of the certified DAG produces it.
DAG_GAP_C.corpus_search_performed_first: As the lane mandate directs. The effective authority corpus was searched for any ratified or derived removal rule that deterministically produces the field. Result: SECRET_CUSTODY_CONTRACT.CONSEQUENT_BINDING_REQUIREMENT REQUIRES the field; the DAG's SSL06_INVENTORY_PREREQUISITE lists it among the seven pre-mint fields but gives it no source, while sourcing its sibling 'the expiry' to N09 explicitly; HC1_CONTRACT's HC1-S6 sources it to 'N06 planned removal date', which is the consuming node itself; and the N06 package's own FIELD_DISPOSITION gives it closure_path 'Same as expiry_exact_utc', resolving to N09, whose act computes VALID UNTIL. NO DETERMINISTIC PRODUCER EXISTS.
DAG_GAP_C.placement: Downstream of N08, upstream of N06.
DAG_GAP_C.CLASSIFICATION: HUMAN_SUPPLIED_EXECUTION_DATUM, not a mechanically derived schedule datum.
DAG_GAP_C.why_not_mechanically_derived: A derivation needs a ratified offset from a known instant, and none exists. OD-1 fixes that removal is POST-WITNESS but fixes no interval. OD-3's twenty-four hours is ratified for VALID UNTIL, a different quantity; borrowing it would be taking a numeral ratified for another purpose.
DAG_GAP_C.why_it_is_NOT_turned_into_a_policy_decis: The policy is already ratified at OD-1 and is not reopened. Only the concrete instant implementing it is missing — the same relationship N08 bears to OD-3.
DAG_GAP_C.NO_DATE_IS_INVENTED: No UTC timestamp is computed, defaulted or recorded anywhere in this package.
DAG_GAP_C.NOT_SILENTLY_EQUATED_TO_expiry_exact_utc: The two are distinct fields with distinct meanings and no controlling authority requires equality. The one derivable binding bound is NOT EARLIER THAN the planned FINAL WITNESS. Whether it must also fall at or before the expiry is carried as an OPEN OWNER INPUT, not resolved by inference.

CORRECTION_2_EXPIRY_CLOSURE_SEQUENCING_R.why_it_cannot_be_executed_as_written: Edge E-06-10 is HARD. A field first recorded at N10 could never have been present at N06, so N06's exit condition could never be met and N10 could never legitimately begin. CORRECTION_2_EXPIRY_CLOSURE_SEQUENCING_R.what_is_NOT_weakened: EXEC-NOTE-1 is untouched: if no concrete planned FINAL WITNESS time is available, MR-2 remains BLOCKED and no default, estimate or open-ended value is substituted. Keeping the structured pointer beside the resolved value means a transcription that drifts from its source is DETECTABLE rather than authoritative — the resolved value can always be checked back against the row the pointer names. Replacing the pointer with the value would have closed the conflict and lost the traceability in the same move.

CORRECTION_D_UTC_REPRESENTATION_IS_MECHA.what_v1_0_0_constrained: value_utc was a hole_string: any non-empty string.
CORRECTION_D_UTC_REPRESENTATION_IS_MECHA.why_that_is_insufficient: DAG node N09's exit condition requires 'one exact UTC instant, expressed in UTC and not in a local Windows time zone'. CORRECTION_D_UTC_REPRESENTATION_IS_MECHA.what_v1_0_1_adds: A utc_instant definition: either the literal NOT_EXECUTED, or the literal UNKNOWN, or an RFC3339 instant with a literal Z and optional fractional seconds. The two pre-population literals are preserved so an unfilled hole stays a hole rather than becoming a violation.
CORRECTION_D_UTC_REPRESENTATION_IS_MECHA.no_policy_is_invented: The constraint expresses a requirement the DAG already states. It fixes no expiry, no offset and no date.
CORRECTION_D_UTC_REPRESENTATION_IS_MECHA.APPLIED_ALSO_TO_timestamp_utc_AND_WHY_TH: The lane mandate scoped this correction to value_utc. The same definition is also applied to human_confirmation.timestamp_utc, which REQUIRED_CONTENTS item 7 requires for each of the three human confirmations. The rationale is that it is the identical mechanical constraint on an identically named quantity, and a confirmation timestamp recorded in local Windows time corrupts the non-transferability audit that HC-1's own clauses depend on. It is recorded here as a DELIBERATE EXTENSION BEYOND THE STATED SCOPE rather than folded in silently, so a certifier can reject it as scope creep if it disagrees. See OF-CONS-3.
CORRECTION_D_UTC_REPRESENTATION_IS_MECHA.MUTANTS_NOW_RED: A mutant setting value_utc to a local time string, and a mutant setting hc_1 timestamp_utc to a local time string, both fail on keyword 'const' within the utc_instant oneOf.

OPEN_FINDINGS.finding: THREE OF THIS PACKAGE'S OWN NEGATIVE CONTROLS WERE FIRST WRITTEN SO THAT THEY WOULD HAVE REDDENED ON CLEAN ARTIFACTS. Running them exposed the flaw in the controls rather than a defect in the write set.
the_three_cases: CN3 grepped the write set for the phrase 'N31 is SATISFIED'. The manifest carrying that control is itself inside the write set, so the control matched its own description. Rewritten as a structural assertion over named fields.

CN4 grepped for concrete mechanism names and called any hit RED. Every hit was a name appearing inside a PROHIBITION ('never setx'). A control that reddens on its own prohibitions forces the constraint lists to be written vaguely, which is the opposite of what they are for. Rewritten to classify each hit as SELECTION or PROHIBITION.

CN6 grepped for SQ-6 and SQ-7. Those strings are the canonical literals' IDENTIFIERS, and REQUIRED_CONTENTS item 14 positively REQUIRES a statement that neither literal was resolved — which cannot be written without naming them. Rewritten to target resolutions rather than identifiers.
OPEN_FINDINGS.the_generalizable_lesson: A grep-based control that scans a file set including the file that describes it will always find itself; and a control that counts hits rather than classifying them cannot distinguish naming-to-forbid from naming-to-select. Both produce a RED that looks like a finding and is an artefact of the control.
OPEN_FINDINGS.why_it_is_recorded_rather_than_quietly_f: The same defect class already has repository precedent in a vocabulary sweep that miscounted because it did not classify its hits individually. Recording it here is cheaper than letting the next lane rediscover it as an alarm.
OPEN_FINDINGS.what_a_certifier_should_press: Whether any OTHER control in this manifest, or in the three child manifests, counts hits where it should classify them — the N07 child manifest's DN2 and DN3 are worth reading with that question in mind.
